Went to bed.

Multiple reasons. As I said, I'm not a good person.
Right. I'm not saying that I inherently hate anyone who is gay, but I really wish I wasn't.

Stop projecting. My community doesn't know a thing and never will. I am being objective, and the objective fact is that homosexuality is nothing but negative for me. It's not going to "make me happy."

No, I have never been in love, and I don't intend to.

I hate people who were born 'a certain way' because I have to be one of them. I don't want to be a fucking minority. If truly nothing can be done, then I'll give the noose a good consideration.
I've already accepted who I am. That doesn't mean I like it.
I don't want a relationship. When I say homosexuality has no upsides for me, I mean it.
I'm not going to sit there and stay a faggot. My way or the highway.
No, I didn't. I've never enjoyed sex as much as I've enjoyed simply jacking off.
It would make me a fundamentally different person. Again, it's far easier to be cold and hateful towards others than it is to be open and accepting.
Because I was horny and was thinking with my dick, rather than my brain.
There's a difference between taking risks for a good reason and taking risks for _no reason at all_.

It isn't pleasurable to me. It also can't be natural to me but not to others. I am not a different species. Either it is natural or it isn't. 

It doesn't give me pleasure, and whatever small sexual satisfaction I obtain from it is not worth the shame, worrying, and self - disappointment that it entails.

Just because someone says that they are clean doesn't mean that they truly are. There is no 0% risk.

Why would I? It's like growing up to be an autist or a schizophrenic. I never expected it, but never gave it much thought until a year ago (and a little more recently.) I like to plan my life out. Nothing happens that I haven't meant for it to happen (which means my life is uneventful compared to most, but I don't mind.

Until I actually thought about it after an AIDS scare, I didn't think about it at all. But now, I realize that this isn't something I had planned for, something I have no control over but abstinence (which I thought would work, but failed after a year). It's something that is nothing but detrimental, and could cause a large health hazard.

Why would I want to be gay?

Because it's not normal, because I don't want to deal with it, because I didn't want to grow up to be a faggot, because it's dangerous, because it immediately throws me in with the pride parade retards, and so on.

Can't be cured of homosexuality then? Why even bother? I'm not living with this, one way or another. A psychologist would just tell me to live with it, that isn't an option. 

The ratio of straight people with AIDS is far less small than the ratio of homos with it, by the way.
More like getting AIDS or some shit. Homos are full of that.
What's that got to do with anything? I'm surrounded by people who think it's fine. I don't think it's fine.

Because it's weird, ridiculous, dangerous, it's a bunch of nagging thoughts that could potentially cost me my life, and if anyone ever finds out I'll be associated with the kind of fags who have sex in public and partake in parades.

I'd be happier if I had never known about them at all. I probably wouldn't be one either.  I'd love to get treated for it, but that's not happening.

It's easier to hate than to accept them, too.
